sections.heading: Why Agents Need Memory
sections.body: LLMs have a fixed context window that vanishes after each request. Embeddings convert text into vectors that capture semantic meaning — enabling long-term recall.

sections.heading: The Embedding Pipeline
sections.body: Text flows through an embedding model into a vector database, where similarity search retrieves the most relevant context.

sections.heading: RAG Retrieval
sections.body: Embed the query, search for similar memories, and inject the best matches into the prompt as context.

sections.heading: Memory Strategies
sections.body: Choose your architecture based on recency, cost, and relevance.
bulletPoints: Sliding Window — keep last N messages
Vector Recall — embed everything, retrieve by relevance
Hybrid — combine all three for production
